clue.text: Monster with wings, animal that's grey and black

blocks.note: Jumbo is a pet name for an elephant, a grey animal
jet is a deep glossy black

explanation.surface: A description of some winged monster, perhaps a giant grey-and-black creature from a fantasy film.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a playful description of a huge airliner: a monster that happens to have wings.
explanation.definitionFit: A wide-bodied airliner is an enormous aircraft, so jokingly a monster with wings.

clue.text: Honest face, happy to go ahead

indicators.note: going ahead means this word is placed in front of the other one

blocks.note: to be up is to be cheerful
the face of a building is its front

explanation.surface: An honest face looks happy as someone gets the go-ahead.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who is frank and open about things is honest and straightforward with you.

clue.text: Joy and suffering fine in queen, say? Ridiculous!

indicators.note: something suffering is in a bad way, so these letters are knocked out of shape
in places these letters inside the word for the queen

blocks.note: a queen is one example of a bee
taken as written, for rearranging
OK means fine, all right

explanation.surface: Someone protests that a royal being fined for joy and suffering is absurd.
explanation.walkthrough: The queen is not royalty but the queen bee, split open around the shuffled letters plus OK.
explanation.definitionFit: Something beyond a joke has gone past being amusing and become absurd or intolerable.

clue.text: Military council turning towards journalists

indicators.note: turning round makes the letters run backwards

blocks.note: at can mean towards, as in 'aim at'
the NUJ is the National Union of Journalists in Britain

explanation.surface: A military council turns its attention towards the press.
explanation.definitionFit: A junta is a group of officers ruling a country after seizing power.

clue.text: More appealing stunner catches clothing in taxi

indicators.note: the letters that clothe a word are the ones on its outside edges
to catch something is to hold it inside

blocks.note: a Taser is a stun gun
the first and last letters of taxi

explanation.surface: A beautiful passenger is seen catching some clothing in the door of a cab.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stunner' suggests a beauty but is the electric stun gun.
explanation.definitionFit: Tastier is used informally for more attractive or appealing, not just better flavoured.

clue.text: Bird circling saw wreck

indicators.note: circling something means going all the way round it

blocks.note: the jay is a bird of the crow family
to saw off a branch is to lop it

explanation.surface: A bird circling overhead spotted a shipwreck.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Saw' reads as the past tense of see but is the verb for cutting.
explanation.definitionFit: A jalopy is a battered old car, a wreck on wheels.

clue.text: Vessel seen after juice tipped over, went

indicators.note: something tipped over is upended, so its letters run the other way
after says the vessel and the seen word follow the juice

blocks.note: OJ is orange juice
an urn is a vessel
eyed means looked at, seen

explanation.surface: A jug or vase was noticed after someone knocked over their juice and left.
explanation.definitionFit: To have journeyed is to have travelled, the same sense as went somewhere.

clue.text: Story female extracted from biography

indicators.note: extracted from means pulled out of, leaving the rest behind

blocks.note: F is the abbreviation for female
a life is a biography, as in a life of Dickens

explanation.surface: A tale about a woman has been extracted from a biography.
explanation.definitionFit: A story can mean a falsehood, as in a child telling stories, which is a fib.

clue.text: Faint permit impermissible

blocks.note: a pass is a permit
out means not allowed, ruled out

explanation.surface: A permit that is only faintly impermissible: a bureaucratic grey area.
explanation.definitionFit: To pass out is to lose consciousness, the verb sense of faint.

clue.text: Otherworldly sightings, evidence of poltergeist in kitchen?

blocks.note: first meaning: alien craft reported in the sky
second meaning: crockery hurled through the air by a ghost

explanation.walkthrough: The second reading is literal: a poltergeist throws things, so small dishes would be airborne.
explanation.definitionFit: UFOs are popularly called by this name, and a ghost throwing crockery would make it literal.

clue.text: Top of rod in retinal structure: a part of the eye

indicators.note: the top of a word written downward is its first letter
in places one piece inside the retinal structure

blocks.note: the first letter of rod
cones are light-sensitive cells in the retina
taken as written

explanation.surface: An anatomy lesson on the rods and cones of the retina and other parts of the eye.
explanation.walkthrough: Rods and cones are both retinal cells, so 'rod' sits naturally in the surface while serving only for its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: The cornea is the clear front layer covering the iris and pupil.

clue.text: Lighting good in houses: charged item to accommodate it

indicators.note: something that houses another holds it within
to accommodate a guest is to take them in

blocks.note: taken as written
G is the abbreviation for good
an ion is an electrically charged particle
taken as written

explanation.surface: Advice on home lighting: good wiring in houses, with charged parts fitted to take it.
explanation.walkthrough: The second container takes the first result and the charged item together as the host, with 'it' slipped between them.
explanation.definitionFit: Ignition is the act of setting something alight, so lighting a fire or an engine.

clue.text: Seafood in spring water freshly prepared

indicators.note: something freshly prepared has been newly made up, so the letters are put together anew

blocks.note: taken as written, for rearranging

explanation.surface: A recipe for seafood cooked in fresh spring water.
explanation.definitionFit: These large striped shrimps are a popular kind of shellfish, an example of seafood.

clue.text: Pinkish-red tube alongside blocked with fluff

indicators.note: something blocked with a substance has it stuck inside

blocks.note: a drinking straw is a tube
by means next to, alongside
to fluff a line is to get it wrong, to err

explanation.surface: A pink-red pipe lying next to another one that is clogged up with lint.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fluff' looks like lint clogging the tube; it is the verb for making a mistake.
explanation.definitionFit: The colour named after the ripe fruit is a pinkish shade of red.

clue.text: Spot extraordinary talent in cricketer

indicators.note: in places one piece inside the cricketer

blocks.note: a batter is a cricketer who bats
ESP, extrasensory perception, is a supernatural gift

explanation.surface: A talent scout spots remarkable ability in a young cricketer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Extraordinary' seems to describe a gifted player, but extraordinary talent is the psychic kind.
explanation.definitionFit: To bespatter is to splash or speckle something, covering it in spots.

clue.text: Nerve centre

blocks.note: first meaning: courage, bravery
second meaning: the inner core or innards of something

explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads as the nerve centre of an operation; the two words are separate meanings.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means courage informally and also the inner workings or heart of something.

clue.text: Do a clipped fastener

indicators.note: something clipped has had its end trimmed off

blocks.note: taken as written
a frog is a decorative braided loop fastening on a coat

explanation.surface: A short instruction to fasten something with a clip.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Do' looks like a verb but is a hairdo.
explanation.definitionFit: A do is a hairstyle, and this one is a rounded mass of tight curls.

clue.text: Mile or two off, land sought by driver?

blocks.note: first meaning: a good distance away
second meaning: on a golf course, the mown strip a tee shot aims for

explanation.walkthrough: The driver is a golfer's club, not a motorist looking for somewhere a mile or two away.
explanation.definitionFit: A golfer hits a tee shot with a driver, aiming to land on the mown strip between tee and green.

clue.text: Switched around, less damaging

indicators.note: switched means swapped about, so the letters change places

blocks.note: taken as written, for rearranging
taken as written, for rearranging

explanation.surface: Changing sides makes a remark do less harm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Less damaging' reads as one phrase; 'less' is fodder and 'damaging' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Slanderous remarks harm a person's reputation, so they are damaging.

clue.text: Flavouring with sandwiches duly noted

indicators.note: a sandwich holds its filling between two outer layers

blocks.note: and means with, along with
'I see' is what you say to show you have duly noted something

explanation.surface: A memo acknowledging that the sandwiches come with a flavouring.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sandwiches' looks like food, fitting the flavouring, but it is the verb for enclosing.
explanation.definitionFit: The seed of the anise plant is used to give a liquorice taste to food and drink.

clue.text: Announce new nurse I found touring hospital

indicators.note: new means made over, so the letters take a fresh order
touring means going round, so these letters wrap round another

blocks.note: taken as written, for rearranging
H is the map abbreviation for hospital

explanation.surface: Someone announces that a new nurse was found while being shown round the hospital.
explanation.definitionFit: To usher in is to herald or introduce the arrival of something, as an announcement does.

clue.text: Fantastic IT grade: one for these people?

indicators.note: fantastic means wildly imagined, so the letters are fancifully rearranged

blocks.note: taken as written, for rearranging
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: Praise for a top result in information technology, the kind of mark these people would earn.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition leans on the whole clue: these are the people a fantastic IT grade would belong to.
explanation.definitionFit: The digerati are the computer-savvy elite, experts in information technology.

clue.text: Line to the left with your name

indicators.note: across the grid, going to the left means reading right to left

blocks.note: a row is a line
thy is the old form of your

explanation.surface: An instruction on a form: write the line to the left, with your name.
explanation.definitionFit: A worthy is a notable or important person, the same sense as a big name.

clue.text: Writer lacking in cultivation, we're told

indicators.note: being told something means hearing it said rather than seeing it written

blocks.note: wild land or plants are uncultivated

explanation.surface: A writer is said to be uncultured.
explanation.walkthrough: Oscar Wilde was the Irish playwright and wit.
explanation.definitionFit: Oscar Wilde wrote The Importance of Being Earnest, so he is a famous author.

clue.text: Rat, train dispatcher?

blocks.note: first meaning: an informer who exposes wrongdoing
second meaning, taken literally: the guard who sounds a whistle to send a train off

explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the literal reading: on a platform, a guard blows a whistle to start the train.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who reports misconduct to the authorities is called a rat by those exposed.

clue.text: I save it pretty well

blocks.note: taken as written
'save it!' is a demand for quiet, just like 'sh!'

explanation.surface: Someone claims they save money pretty well.
explanation.definitionFit: Ish is informal for roughly or approximately, so almost but not quite.

clue.text: He enters country without US zip code?

definitions.note: zip is nothing, code is a cipher: both senses fit

indicators.note: without means lacking, so those letters are left out
someone who enters a room goes inside it, so this word is put within the other

blocks.note: taken as written
Cyprus is a Mediterranean island country
taken as written, as the letters to remove

explanation.surface: An American arrives somewhere abroad with no postal code to give.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Zip code' suggests a US postcode; read apart, zip means nothing (zero) and code means a secret code, and the answer is both.
explanation.definitionFit: A cypher is a zero, a nonentity, and also a secret coded system of writing.

clue.text: Food additive that may be used in curing process?

definitions.text: that may be used in curing process?

blocks.note: first meaning: a sauce such as vinaigrette for a salad

blocks.clueFragment: that may be used in curing process?
blocks.note: second meaning: a bandage put on a wound to help it heal

explanation.walkthrough: 'Curing' looks like preserving meat, keeping us in the kitchen, but here it is healing.
explanation.definitionFit: A salad sauce and a covering for a wound share this name.
